title: Staging Auto Pilot and environment-aware OAuth certification maintenance

phases.objective: Keep Staging Auto Pilot lifecycle, environment authority, GPT Actions OAuth compatibility, and exact certification evidence within one reviewed maintenance PR without Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The local Staging One-Click Auto Pilot evaluates an exact main candidate and the Tenant GPT OAuth contract.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The lifecycle passes logging, eligibility, service readiness, environment authority, OAuth metadata/PKCE compatibility, certification, and fail-closed Production boundaries.
steps: Validate the exact candidate and the local-only Staging deployment boundary.
Preserve existing local secrets while filling only missing non-secret compatibility defaults.
Validate GPT Actions-compatible OAuth authorization and token contracts independently for Staging and Production identities.
Run service health, certification, provenance, readback, and redacted evidence checks.
Reject migrations, grants, provider mutations, Production deployment, and credential payload exposure.
Confirm the resulting evidence is bound to the exact candidate SHA.
assertions: The invalid warn log level cannot crash Auto Pilot after service health.
Staging and Production OAuth hosts, client identities, resource values, and scope authorities remain environment-separated.
GPT Actions no-PKCE compatibility is restricted to the canonical client in each environment and explicit false remains a strict-PKCE rollback switch.
Existing non-empty secrets are preserved and no secret payload is committed or emitted.
No Production mutation, deployment, migration, grant, provider mutation, or force push is introduced.
